name: zenroute
description: ZenRoute CLI - Serene AI Gateway & Intelligent Routing Engine

scripts.dev: nodemon -I --watch cli.js --watch src --watch hooks --ext js,json cli.js

comment_sqlite: sql.js + better-sqlite3 are NOT bundled here. They are installed into runtime directories (~/.zenroute/runtime or ~/.9router/runtime) by hooks/postinstall.js.
comment_systray: systray2 is NOT bundled here. It is lazy-installed into runtime directories by hooks/postinstall.js.
